description: This source file defines the class ChronologicalEvictionStrategy, which implements a cache eviction strategy based on the age of messages. It manages buffers, handles purging of old messages, and integrates with monitoring and logging components within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: ChronologicalEvictionStrategy
classes.description: Implements a time-age based eviction strategy, managing buffers and purging old cache entries based on age predicates, with support for external monitoring and logging.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports the current cache size to the cache monitor.

methods.name: OnBlockAllocated
methods.description: Handles the allocation of a new buffer block, updating internal state and metrics.

methods.name: PerformPurge
methods.description: Performs a purge based on the current time, removing expired messages.

methods.name: ShouldPurge
methods.description: Determines whether a cached message should be purged based on age and reference parameters.

methods.name: PerformPurgeInternal
methods.description: Contains the core logic for purging old cache messages.

methods.name: FreePurgedBuffers
methods.description: Releases buffers associated with purged messages and updates memory tracking.

methods.name: ReportPurge
methods.description: Logs details about the purge activity, including number of items purged and cache size.

methods.name: LogBlockPurgedCacheEmpty
methods.description: Logs that the cache has been completely emptied after a purge.

methods.name: LogBlockPurged
methods.description: Logs purge details including count of purged blocks and resulting cache size.
